narrator_character_id.description: For first-person narration, the id of the narrating character (an existing id or one from new_characters). Empty string for third-person narration.

present.description: Characters already in the bible who appear in this chapter. Do not list new characters here.

spoken_lines.description: Approximate count of their spoken lines in this chapter.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug, e.g. ned-land. Never reuse an existing id.

name.description: Canonical name as the story most often uses it.

aliases.description: Every other way the text refers to them: titles, nicknames, epithets, surname alone.

role.description: One sentence: who they are in the story.

description.description: Two or three sentences on identity and manner, using only what the text has revealed so far.

voice_brief.description: How the voice should sound, as a text-to-speech voice-design description: sex, apparent age, pitch, timbre, pace, accent or register, mannerisms. Quote the textual cues it rests on.

evidence.description: A short quote from the chapter establishing the character.

updates.description: Changes to characters already in the bible: new aliases, newly revealed facts, a revised voice brief.

new_facts.description: Facts this chapter reveals that matter for casting or attribution.

voice_brief_update.description: A full replacement voice brief if this chapter changes how the voice should sound; otherwise empty string.

role_update.description: A replacement one-sentence role if the bible's is now wrong or stale (e.g. an unnamed narrator who has been named); otherwise empty string.

description_update.description: A replacement two-or-three-sentence description if the bible's is now wrong or stale; otherwise empty string.

pronunciations.description: Names or terms an English text-to-speech voice would likely mispronounce, with a plain-syllable respelling.

respelling.description: Plain syllables with the stressed syllable in capitals, e.g. ah-roh-NAKS.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what happens in this chapter, for the chapter log.
